publisher_meaning.section: page 6: line 11(a)(ii), individual/person contributions not required to be itemized on Schedule A

paper.scope: Reuse qualified P3.4 cover identity, dates, response completeness, and cover multiplicity checks. Preserve observed values even when scope blocks comparison.

metadata.accepted_values: Pinned number|string|null shape. Preserve raw JSON type; parse signed plain decimal numbers and strings to checked cents. Empty string, null, invalid, and zero are distinct.
metadata.filings_endpoint: not_supplied_by_endpoint, not a null or zero monetary assertion
metadata.other_endpoints: unsupported_endpoint; retain original metadata without remapping to Form 3X
metadata.period: Preserve each assertion's own valid date or midnight-without-zone dates; do not borrow dates from another source.

arithmetic.formula: total minus itemized minus explicitly reported unitemized
arithmetic.purpose: An exact intra-assertion diagnostic only. Never solve for a missing operand or replace unitemized with the residual.

reported_pair.rule: Same exact file, filer, form, report code, paper origin, amendment indicator and period; complete qualified paper response; both explicit unitemized operands valid. Each metadata observation is separate.
reported_pair.delta: metadata minus paper unitemized cents; null if pair is blocked
reported_pair.subtotal_conflict: Keep visible without erasing the explicit unitemized observation or blocking a same-field reported pair solely because sibling fields disagree. Does not qualify a financial component.
reported_pair.missing_cover: Metadata observation can remain available with its own scope; no pair is fabricated.
